title: Cast-Iron Green Chilli Cheeseburger Sliders
changes_from_base: Green chillies are softened with onion and garlic and blended to a paste that seasons both the thin beef patties and a lime mayonnaise, and the sliders are seared hard in cast iron and topped with melting pepper Jack.
summary: These sliders carry the gentle heat of green chillies right through the beef, with a cooling lime-spiked sauce and melting pepper Jack on top.
equipment: large cast-iron frying pan with a lid

ingredients.item: tinned chopped mild green chillies, rinsed and patted dry
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
Monterey Jack with jalapeños (pepper Jack), grated
soft white dinner rolls, split and toasted

steps.title: Chilli
steps.text: Heat 30 ml vegetable oil in a large cast-iron frying pan over medium for 3 min, cook 1 finely chopped medium onion for about 5 min until soft, then add 300 g rinsed and patted dry tinned chopped mild green chillies and 1 finely chopped garlic clove for 1 min.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Transfer the cooked chilli mixture to a food processor and blend until smooth.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Mix 120 ml of the chilli paste with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp lime juice and ¼ tsp salt; set aside for serving.

steps.title: Meat
steps.text: Knead the remaining chilli paste with 450 g beef mince, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp ground black pepper.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Make 12 loose balls from the mixture and flatten them to 6 mm patties slightly wider than the rolls.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Refrigerate the patties for at least 30 min, or up to 24 hours in advance.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Wipe the pan, heat over medium for 5 min, add 1 tbsp oil until just smoking; cook 4 patties without moving for about 2 min until well browned, flip with 2 fish slices, top each with a heaped tbsp of grated Monterey Jack with jalapeños, cover and cook for 2 min until melted and the centre reaches 71 °C.

steps.title: Batch
steps.text: Repeat in 2 more batches with the remaining oil and patties.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Place each slider in a toasted soft white dinner roll and serve with the chilli sauce.

tips: Ensure the chillies are blended to a completely smooth paste for even flavouring of both the meat and sauce
Make the patties slightly wider than the rolls so they shrink to fit properly during cooking
Use 2 fish slices to flip the patties securely without breaking them
storage: These sliders are best served immediately. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
